entries.subject: DAMIT 4057: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 4057, version 2019-05-07, pole (81°, 1°), period 32.9961 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 4058 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 118.929 ± 2.856 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 118.929 ± 2.856 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2011, ApJ 741, 68; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown rotation "32.9961 hours" (damit-models) differs from the LCDB V4.0 summary record 410 period 32.50 h (U 3, synodic); the shown value is kept. Shown size Display reference radius "59.46 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 239, DAMIT model 4057 diameter 112 ± 1 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 4057 fitted to 1 occultation); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.

entries.subject: Chloris whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 27 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.916 at 462 nm, 0.977 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#3b3a37 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 4.3% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.7%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2011, ApJ 741, 68; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
